blocks.html: Wellness today is no longer seen as an occasional luxury. It has become an essential part of living well, found in morning routines, mindful rituals, and healthier habits practiced daily. Whether it’s making time for movement, investing in better skin, or simply stepping away from the demands of the day to take a breather, more people are making intentional choices to care for themselves. And while these practices may look different for everyone, having a place where they come together makes prioritizing well-being all the more effortless.

As more people embrace a holistic approach to self-care, Opus, Robinsons Land's premium lifestyle mall in Bridgetowne, brings together a thoughtfully curated collection of fitness, beauty, and wellness experiences. Here, every visit is an opportunity to slow down, recharge, and cultivate a healthier, more balanced lifestyle.

Every wellness journey begins with movement. At Fitness First Platinum, world-class equipment, premium facilities and an extensive selection of group classes create an inspiring environment for every kind of workout. With personalized coaching and comprehensive training programs, achieving your wellness goals becomes both effortless and rewarding.
If your idea of movement leans toward mindfulness, SCOOP Pilates Studio offers private reformer sessions and group classes that strengthen the body while enhancing balance, flexibility, and posture.
Looking after yourself goes beyond staying active. Sometimes, it's as simple as setting aside time for the beauty rituals that leave you feeling refreshed and confident.
Whether you're due for a fresh haircut or a nourishing treatment, Basement Salon offers expert hair and beauty services tailored to help you look and feel your best.

Complete your self-care routine with beautifully shaped brows at Strokes Nail Spa and Wellness Studio, enhance your lashes at Ayumi or at Lueur House of Beauty, enjoy a hassle-free waxing appointment at Maxwax or a premium laser treatment at Wink Laser Studio, then indulge yourself to a mani-pedi session Nail Vitale.

blocks.html: Gentlemen can likewise elevate their grooming routine at The Dojo, a premium barbershop inspired by the timeless elegance and precision of Japanese craftsmanship, where every cut is tailored with meticulous attention to detail.
Beyond fitness and beauty, wellness is also about making time to pause and recharge. For moments when you need to slow down, Opus offers restorative experiences designed to help you unwind.

Enjoy a therapeutic massage or body treatment at The Spa Wellness, designed to soothe tired muscles and melt away tension. For those seeking an even deeper sense of relaxation, Senses Nail and Beauty's signature Taoyaka Head Spa combines a soothing head massage with a nourishing hair treatment, creating a calming ritual that refreshes both mind and body.

The wellness experience at Opus continues to evolve with the addition of new brands that further enrich its thoughtfully curated mix of lifestyle offerings. Joining its growing roster is GAOC (Gan Advanced Osseointegration Center), one of the country's leading dental institutions, renowned for its comprehensive dental care, advanced implantology, oral surgery, and state-of-the-art treatment technologies.

Also opening soon is the award-winning Aivee Clinic, bringing its expertise in dermatology, aesthetic medicine, and non-invasive beauty treatments. Together, these highly regarded names further strengthen Opus as a destination where every aspect of well-being comes together.
Make wellness a part of your everyday

Whether you’re stopping by for an energizing workout, a quick beauty appointment, or a well-deserved afternoon of relaxation, Opus makes it effortless to weave wellness into your everyday routine. Discover how intentional moments of care can add up to a healthier, more balanced way of living only at Opus.
